visual_enhancers.gradients: None. Strictly flat colors or subtle noise.

icons.wallet_icons: Use react-icons/si (SiMetamask, SiPhantom) or similar SVG components. Do not use images for wallet icons.

general: Implement a 'Strictly Black' theme. The background must be #000000. No dark grays for the main background.
Use the accent color #C1FF72 for primary actions and success states.
Ensure all borders are high contrast: rgba(255,255,255,0.5).
Border radius must be exactly 10px for all cards, buttons, and inputs.
The Swap Card must be centered and elevated.
Use 'Chivo' font for headings and 'Inter' for body text. Add these fonts via Google Fonts in index.html.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use the provided 'background_texture' image with very low opacity (5-10%) if a texture is needed, otherwise stick to pure black.
layout_structure: Header: Logo (Left), Navigation (Center - Optional), Wallet Connect (Right).
Main Content: Centered Swap Widget (Max width 480px).
Transaction History: Can be a modal or a section below the swap card.

component_overrides.Button: Override Shadcn Button to use 10px radius and the specific colors defined in palette.
component_overrides.Card: Override Shadcn Card to use bg-black, border-white/50, and 10px radius.
component_overrides.Input: Override Shadcn Input to use bg-[#111], border-none, 10px radius, and h-14 height.
component_overrides.Dialog: Ensure modals have a black background and white/20 border.

wallet_integration.logic: Implement a 'Connect Wallet' modal that allows choosing between Phantom (Solana) and MetaMask (EVM).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) sparingly, mainly for the header.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
